the room and the confusion which followed the entry
of the Police party, it was impossible to actually
witness the actions of all the accused people, how-

The accused Cameron, who was sitting on

crudely made pipe commonly used by heroin addicts,
and after being cautioned, he willingly admitted
that he was a drug addict stating that at the time

who conducts the den and immediately placed his
pipe in his pocket.

The accused admitted that during the close
of 1937, whilst evacuated to Hongkong from Shanghai,
he acquired the habit of smoking opium and upon his
return to Shanghai still continued the habit, but
during the past two months owing to financial en-

1940年10月21日下午3时50分，由警司费多罗夫（Fedoroff）、巡佐菲利普斯（Phillips）、副巡官666号、华籍巡捕221、271、284、327、353号以及日本领事馆警察成员组成的警察小队，突袭了布恩路572弄34号，在该处所底层前屋内，被告乔治·亨利·格拉修斯·卡梅伦（George Henry Gracius Cameron），32岁，单身，无业，生为英国臣民，连同一名朝鲜人、13名中国男性和6名中国女性被捕。由于房间内人数众多，且警察小队进入后造成混乱，实际上不可能目睹所有被告的行为，然而，发现有些人正在吸食海洛因。

被告卡梅伦当时坐在房间最后面的长凳上，并未被实际看到吸食毒品，但当被带到警局时，发现他持有一支海洛因成瘾者常用的粗制烟枪，经警告后，他自愿承认自己是吸毒者， stating that at the time of the police entering the den he was smoking heroin which he had purchased for 30 cents from a Japanese who conducts the den and immediately placed his pipe in his pocket.（陈述称在警察进入烟馆时，他正在吸食以30分向经营该烟馆的一名日本人购买的海洛因，并立即将烟枪放入口袋。）

Range Road is engaged in selling of heroin.

Arrangements were made with the Japanese Consular
Police and with their assistance the place was raided
at 5.40 p.m. 8/8/39. On entering the premises it was
found that D.S. Sugimoto (attached to C.I.) together
with the member of the Japanese Consular Police were
engaged in searching the same premises for arms.

The owner of the premises one named Vera Den,
54, Korean Female was taken into custody and had been
escorted to the Consular Police prior to arrival of
the detectives from Hongkew Station.

The search was continued by two parties but no
heroin or arms were found. 14 pawn tickets and several
notes and letters apparently connected with dealing
in narcotics were found on the premises and with per-
mission from the officers of the Japanese Consular
Police were seized for further enquiries.

The son of Vera Den one named Yoh Kah Shaku, 28,
Korean, was also taken in custody by the Consular Police
for questioning.

Enquiries proceeding.
